method: Per app: read the extracted screen table (screens.json), then eyeball the app's committed README screenshots for the main task screen and key states. Pass = one dominant task action (primary_button, row-tap list idiom, transport control, or by-design art/board screen) with secondary controls in stable chrome slots (app bar, bottom action bar). Finding = anything that reads as two competing dominants or no dominant where a task action exists.

arxiv.notes: Listing screens: row tap opens the paper (dominant); single bottom control per screen (Any time filter, Manage); back in app bar. Evidence: apps/arxiv/screenshots/listing.png, saved.png.

audiobook.notes: Player screen passes (transport centered, play dominant by placement; Bluetooth output / Create another in stable bottom bar). FINDING: empty shelf state shows two equal-weight buttons side by side - 'Create an audiobook' (the task) and 'Play the sample' (demo path). Create should read as the one dominant action. Evidence: examples/audiobook/screenshots/shelf.png, player.png.

backgammon.notes: Board-centric game screen; the single turn verb (Roll/Double/Undo) lives in a stable bottom action bar; match-over dialog uses primary_button (New match). Evidence: apps/backgammon/screenshots/backgammon-play.png.

birds.notes: By design the art plate is the screen (no app bar over it); navigation is the SDK reading chrome (page_turns + reading_menu). Error/empty states use splash + single Refresh button. Evidence: apps/birds/screenshots/birds.png.

brief.notes: Story list: row tap opens the story; single Refresh control in bottom bar; Source switcher in stable top-right chrome; sources screen has single Brief return control. Evidence: examples/brief/screenshots/brief.png, sources.png.

calibre-web.notes: Libraries screen: primary 'Add library' + plain 'Downloaded books'; account choice: primary 'Sign in' + plain 'Use public library'; book screen: primary 'Download'. Catalog: rows dominant, list-continuation paging, single 'Libraries' bottom control. Failure/offline dialogs use Try again / Cancel pairs (SDK dialog idiom). Evidence: apps/calibre-web/screenshots/catalog.png + screens.json.

chat.notes: Tab idiom (Conversation/Type/Service) in stable bottom tab bar; empty state directs to the Type tab; compose is the SDK text-entry sheet; errors get a single Try again. Evidence: examples/chat/screenshots/start.png, answer.png + screens.json.

crossword.notes: Grid is the interaction surface (tap cell, type); clue caption above; stable bottom bar (Clues/More); list paging via action_bar Previous/Next. Evidence: apps/crossword/screenshots/crossword-play.png.

deck.notes: Setup sheets use primary buttons (Enter the address / Enter the code). Main screen is a tool-tile launcher grid (equal tiles = pick-a-tool idiom) with refresh in top-right chrome. Evidence: apps/deck/screenshots/deck.png + screens.json.

fanshelf.notes: Shelf: rows dominant (tap work to open/download); Filter/Add in stable top-right chrome; Followed tags / Updates / Manage are equal-weight section shortcuts above the list (navigation, not competing task actions); empty states single-purpose splashes; manage confirm is a dialog pair. Evidence: apps/fanshelf/screenshots/shelf.png, manage-confirm.png + screens.json.

fieldbook.notes: Home: one dominant 'Start an outing' button centered on the Today tab; stable bottom tab bar (Today/Packs/Search/Life list/Export). Evidence: apps/fieldbook/screenshots/home.png.

flashcards.notes: Decks: empty-state splash with transfer entry in top-right chrome; first-use single 'Start with the sample'; review screen primary 'Reveal answer' with card paging in stable chrome; done state is a plain splash. Evidence: apps/flashcards/screenshots/decks.png, first-use.png + screens.json.

frame.notes: Photo-viewing idiom like birds: the photo is the screen; navigation via SDK page_turns/reading_menu; state screens use single 'Next photo' buttons; settings in modal. Evidence: screens.json (frame-home/frame-show).

grimoire.notes: Home is a tile launcher (Spells etc.); reference screens use SDK reading chrome (Aa/light/page turns); filters screen action_bar pair Clear filters / View results (action-bar idiom). Evidence: apps/grimoire/screenshots/rule.png, spell-filters.png + screens.json.

gutenbird.notes: Book screen: exactly one primary per state (Read XOR Read sample XOR plain availability text - the two primaries in the raw table are a match on ReadOffer, not co-present); 'Choose download' plain secondary only when multiple formats. Catalog/shelf: primary 'Choose a catalog'. Evidence: examples/gutenbird/screenshots/book.png, shelf.png + main.rs:1948-1962.

habits.notes: Tab bar (Today/Streaks/Manage/Stats) at top, consistent across tabs; row tap toggles completion (dominant); single 'Add a habit' entry; Manage/Stats single-purpose buttons. Evidence: apps/habits/screenshots/done.png, empty.png + screens.json.

hn.notes: Story rows dominant (tap opens thread); stable bottom tab bar (Top/New/Ask/Show); errors single primary 'Try again'; thread screen page_turns chrome. Evidence: examples/hn/screenshots/stories.png, thread.png + screens.json.

homepanel.notes: Tile grid is the interaction surface (tap a device tile); Add/Settings in stable top-right chrome; edit mode has explicit Done; climate detail single 'Cooler'-style stepper controls. Evidence: apps/homepanel/screenshots/grid.png, climate.png + screens.json.

inkling.notes: Game screen: single dominant 'Enter guess' button; secondary (Hard mode toggle, stats, today, archive) in stable action bar; guess entry is the SDK keyboard sheet with Guess submit. Evidence: apps/inkling/screenshots/knowledge.png + screens.json.

kitchencard.notes: One primary per state (Add address / Sync Mealie / Pick a recipe / Start cooking); tonight screen: primary 'Start cooking' dominant with plain secondaries (Pick recipe, serving steppers) below; Sync + settings in top-right chrome. Evidence: apps/kitchencard/screenshots/tonight.png, cooking.png + screens.json.

lichess.notes: Home is a mode-tile launcher; pairing candidate: primary 'Open game' + plain 'Keep waiting'; puzzle result: primary 'Next puzzle'; game screen board-centric with modal dialogs (SDK dialog idiom, one primary each); state-labeled buttons (button_with_state) keep positions stable while disabled. Evidence: apps/lichess/screenshots/home.png, candidate.png + screens.json.

logicpack.notes: Collection: puzzle rows dominant + single paging control; play screens board-centric with secondary verbs (Undo/Check/Restart/Rules) grouped in the More sheet; restart confirm is a dialog pair. Evidence: apps/logicpack/screenshots/collection.png, hashi.png + screens.json.

magnet.notes: Guided sweep walkthrough: one contextual step button ('Sweep the right edge') reads dominant above a plain 'Reset the count'; facts display otherwise; no-sensor state is a splash. Evidence: examples/magnet/screenshots/counting.png, no-magnet.png.

morse.notes: Beacon: the flash area is the screen; single state-dependent action-bar verb (Stop while sending, Edit when idle) + Light toggle; writing uses banner; reference is page_turns reading chrome. Evidence: apps/morse/screenshots/sending.png + screens.json.

musicstand.notes: Library: score row tap is dominant (opens on the stand); Setlists/Add scores stacked plain secondaries; stand screen is reading chrome (page_turns, half-turn, zoom, modal page facts). Evidence: apps/musicstand/screenshots/library.png, stand.png + screens.json.

needles.notes: Project screen textbook: one big primary '+1 row', plain secondaries in a stable grid (Undo, Change section, Repeat length, Read synced pattern); library tab bar + primary Sync per empty collection; pattern screen primary 'Follow this pattern' + plain 'Open synced pattern'. Evidence: apps/needles/screenshots/project.png + screens.json.

nonograms.notes: Play screen: board + explicit move-pad idiom with visible disabled states; Undo/More as stable secondaries; browser uses page_turns + action_bar; photo/detail single-purpose buttons; save-recovery dialog pair. Evidence: apps/nonograms/screenshots/play.png + screens.json.

panels.notes: Library: shelf row dominant, stable bottom bar (Add comic / Browse, with state-dependent Retry/Download additions in fixed slots); detail: primary 'Download' + plain reading-order toggle; errors single primary 'Try again'. Evidence: apps/panels/screenshots/library.png + screens.json.

paperterm.notes: Preview screen passes (single 'Connect a computer' CTA + Close preview chrome). FINDING: paperterm-welcome pairs 'Connect a computer' (task) with 'Try a preview' (demo) at equal weight - same shape as the audiobook empty-state finding. Setup/trust sheets use a clean single-Next + Back pattern otherwise. Evidence: screens.json + apps/paperterm/screenshots/preview.png.

parlor.notes: Menu: single primary 'Resume saved game'; setup: primary 'Start game' + plain 'How to play'; board/record screens are board+chrome idioms (Board back button only). Evidence: screens.json + apps/parlor/screenshots/table.png.

parser.notes: Reading/chapter idiom: page_turns navigation + banner chrome; slots browser uses paged page_turns; no competing actions on any screen. Evidence: screens.json + apps/parser/screenshots/parser-game.png.

post.notes: Inbox: letter rows dominant + single 'Check for letters' button + Newer/Older action_bar; letter screen Previous/Inbox/Next action_bar + plain '?' help; opening uses transient activity spinner. Evidence: screens.json + apps/post/screenshots/inbox.png.

pubquiz.notes: Every flow screen has exactly one primary (Continue / Start round / Show result / See podium / Finish round / Start pass-around); secondaries plain (Solo round, How to play) or action_bar Previous/Next/Answer. Verified players.png + question.png. Evidence: screens.json + apps/pubquiz/screenshots/.

readlater.notes: Main list: tabs (Unread/Starred/Archive) + row tap dominant, splashes for empty states, plain 'Sync'/'Add address' on setup/connect states, Archive/Back action_bar in reading view. The unauthenticated state pairs connect splash with primary 'Add address' - single CTA. Evidence: screens.json + apps/readlater/screenshots/readlater-setup.png.

rss.notes: Shelf: feed rows dominant + single primary 'Add a feed' on empty state / 'Try again' on error; rss-found double-primary is a confirmed per-state match (error branch 'Try again' vs empty-result branch 'Try another address', main.rs:577-590); found-feeds list is one_line_row tap idiom; reading screen uses page_turns. Evidence: screens.json + examples/rss/screenshots/browse-feeds.png + source.

rss-miniflux.notes: Tabs + rows dominant; unauthenticated state pairs connect splash with single primary 'Add address'; 'Suggested feeds' plain; Back chrome. Evidence: screens.json + apps/rss-miniflux/screenshots/unread.png.

sidekick.notes: Watching state: splash + plain 'Change pairing'; asking screen: one state button 'Send these answers' + plain Allow/Deny/Leave it for the terminal (a question-answering idiom, no competing primaries); opening/sending are transient activity screens. Evidence: screens.json + examples/sidekick/screenshots/asking.png.

sudoku.notes: Game: board + digit move-pad with visible disabled digits, Digits/Undo/More secondaries (move-pad idiom, same class as nonograms); new-game difficulty buttons are the single purpose of that screen; save-recovery 'Retry save' single action. Verified game.png. Evidence: screens.json + apps/sudoku/screenshots/.

syncthing.notes: Dashboard idiom: banner + facts + Back chrome and Back/About action_bar; no competing actions. Evidence: screens.json + apps/syncthing/screenshots/syncthing-folders.png.

tictactoe.notes: Board game idiom: board is the play surface, plain 'Start again' + action_bar 'How to play'/'Clear score'. Evidence: screens.json + examples/tictactoe/screenshots/game.png.

todo.notes: Per-state add control confirmed in source (main.rs:543-551): empty list gets single primary 'Add a task', populated list gets plain 'Add' beside 'Clear finished'; 'Undo clear' appears only after a clear; row edit offers Rename/Remove with stateful Move up/down. Intentional, documented in code comment. Evidence: screens.json + examples/todo/screenshots/list.png + source.

vault.notes: Home: splash + plain 'About Vault'; browsing screens (tags, recent, backlinks, browse) are row-tap idioms; note screen action_bar Previous/next-page + 'Vault' back; search results single plain 'Search again'. Evidence: screens.json + apps/vault/screenshots/home.png, note.png.

verses.notes: Poem screen action_bar Previous/Quote card/Next (per-state collapse to 'Quote card' alone is state-dependent, not competing); online/search/results are row idioms with splashes for empty states; settings has one state-dependent primary 'Turn off'. Evidence: screens.json + apps/verses/screenshots/today.png, reading.png.

gallery.notes: Component catalog reviewed under APPQA-05 (specimen captions fix, v1.0.14, matrix 27/27 at docs/quality/evidence/gallery-caption/); tabs + paged panels, every enabled specimen acknowledges taps, *-off specimens intentionally inert. Counted here for census completeness.

findings.issue: Two equal-weight buttons: 'Create an audiobook' vs 'Play the sample'. One dominant task action rule: Create should be primary, sample secondary.
findings.proposed_fix: Make 'Create an audiobook' the primary button in the empty shelf state; keep 'Play the sample' as a plain secondary button.

findings.issue: Two equal-weight buttons: 'Connect a computer' (the task) vs 'Try a preview' (demo path).
findings.proposed_fix: Make 'Connect a computer' primary; keep 'Try a preview' plain.
